description: Runs exact cosine similarity search between query embeddings (M x D) and corpus embeddings (N x D) on distributed GPUs using OUTPUT_GRID_2D zero-reduction tiling.

corpus_embeddings.description: File path (.npy/.npz/.safetensors) or inline 2D array of shape (N, D).

output_path.description: Optional file path (.npy/.safetensors) to save the full similarity matrix.

queries.description: File path (.npy/.npz/.safetensors) or inline 2D array of shape (M, D).

top_k.description: Number of top matching corpus indices and scores to return per query.

name: batch_similarity_search
